usa_filter: campaign/adset name contains USA, US, _US, or US_ and excludes AUS/Australia

delivery_comparison.metric_note: Delivery metrics are from Meta. The dashboard overlays Shopify-derived sales from the Shopify comparison export.

fx_rates.note: Meta account spend is converted from account currency to USD using the date-specific Frankfurter v2 rate first; latest/v1 endpoints are only fallbacks and are labeled per date.
